description: Deterministic synthetic repository tool loops for server latency, cache, routing, and lifecycle measurements. This is not an autonomous coding quality suite.

repository_context.name: acme-router
repository_context.base: The repository is a synthetic Python service with an HTTP router, bounded request scheduler, cache, metrics, tests, and deployment notes. The benchmark driver repeats the expansion blocks deterministically until the model tokenizer reaches the workload target prefix size.
expansion_blocks: src/router.py owns route registration and returns typed RouteResult values. It must not perform network I/O while holding the registry lock.
src/scheduler.py admits Request records, enforces active and pending limits, and records queue, first-token, completion, cancellation, and reclaim timestamps.
src/cache.py stores immutable PrefixEntry objects under content hashes. References are counted, writes use copy-on-write, and eviction may remove only unreferenced entries.
src/metrics.py exports request, latency, cache, scheduler-width, cancellation, and ownership measurements. Batch-scoped timing has one declared owner.
tests/test_router.py checks exact route selection and missing-route errors. tests/test_scheduler.py checks delayed admission, cancellation, and final ownership.
docs/operations.md describes queue caps, readiness, bounded shutdown, cache pressure, and the invariant that active work drains to zero.
pyproject.toml defines the acme_router package, Python 3.11 support, pytest defaults, and no optional runtime dependency on a tensor framework.
AGENTS.md requires narrow tests, exact request identity, explicit performance timing scopes, and no hard-coded workload answers.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Run one allow-listed synthetic validation command.

turns.user: Use read with path pyproject.toml and mode summary to inspect the package configuration before suggesting a validation command.
turns.tool_result: Package acme_router targets Python 3.11 and configures pytest with tests/ as the default path.

turns.user: Use grep with pattern def admit and path src to find the scheduler admission API.
Use read with path src/scheduler.py and mode summary to inspect the scheduler implementation around that API.
turns.tool_result: Admission checks pending and active limits, preserves request identity, and records queue and reclaim timestamps.

turns.user: Use run with command python -m pytest -q tests/test_scheduler.py to run the narrow scheduler tests.
Use grep with pattern refcount and path src/cache.py to locate prefix cache ownership rules.
turns.tool_result: src/cache.py contains acquire, release, copy-on-write, and unreferenced-only eviction checks.

turns.user: Use read with path src/cache.py and mode summary to summarize the cache implementation.
turns.tool_result: PrefixEntry values are immutable, keyed by content hash, reference counted, and evicted only at zero references.

turns.user: Use read with path src/metrics.py and mode summary to check which metrics expose cache and batch behavior.
turns.tool_result: Metrics include prefix lookups, hits, reused tokens, cache bytes, physical width, queue wait, TTFT, cancellation, and ownership.

turns.user: Use grep with pattern timing_owner and path src to find the batch timing ownership invariant.
turns.tool_result: src/metrics.py:77: timing_owner must be true for exactly one row in each batch.

turns.user: Use read with path docs/operations.md and mode summary to inspect the operational pressure guidance.
turns.tool_result: Pressure tests cover bounded queue rejection, slow consumers, cancellation, cache eviction, graceful drain, and zero leaked ownership.

turns.user: Use run with command python -m pytest -q to run the full synthetic suite.
Use read with path src/router.py and mode summary to inspect the router contract.
turns.tool_result: The router resolves immutable registrations under a lock and performs no network I/O while the lock is held.

turns.user: Use grep with pattern RouteNotFound and path src to find missing-route handling.
turns.tool_result: src/router.py:68 raises RouteNotFound with the requested route id.

turns.user: Use read with path tests/test_router.py and mode summary to inspect the focused router tests.
turns.tool_result: Tests cover exact route selection, duplicate registration, missing routes, and lock release before execution.

turns.user: Use run with command python -m pytest -q tests/test_router.py to run those tests.
Use grep with pattern cancel and path src/scheduler.py to inspect request cancellation behavior.
turns.tool_result: Cancellation marks the row for reclaim at the next commit point and does not change live neighboring requests.

turns.user: Use read with path tests/test_scheduler.py and mode summary to inspect scheduler cancellation and reclaim tests.
turns.tool_result: Tests cancel a middle row, admit a replacement, verify survivors, and assert pending, active, refs, and producers drain to zero.

turns.user: Use run with command python -m pytest -q tests/test_scheduler.py after the longer tool history.
Use run with command python -m pytest -q to confirm the project-wide validation result.
